source_observations: Official model card identifies Multilingual V3 as the current general-purpose multilingual 500M variant and explicitly includes German among 23+ languages.
Official implementation maps t3_model='v3' to t3_mtl23ls_v3.safetensors.
The public local quickstart exposes generate(...) returning a waveform; no source-grounded incremental local audio streaming ABI was observed in the pinned quickstart/source surface.

The upstream sub-200ms statement on the model card is attached to Resemble AI's commercial TTS service and is not evidence for local Chatterbox V3 TTFA, RTF, end-to-end turn latency or Frankenstein behavior.
The V3 T3 artifact is safetensors, reducing pickle risk for that artifact; complete runtime dependency/artifact auditing is still required before target execution.

frankenstein_interpretation.reason: A full-waveform generate API can still be useful for quality comparison, but it does not by itself satisfy Frankenstein's incremental cancellable realtime TTS requirement.

required_target_runtime_falsifiers: stable male speaker identity over long sessions
chunkability or genuinely incremental synthesis without prosody collapse
barge-in cancellation behavior and no false spoken-state commit
next_exact_action: After the first terminal clay-direct-dev hardware receipt is admitted, benchmark Chatterbox Multilingual V3 against Qwen3-TTS, MagpieTTS and Piper/Thorsten on German TTFA/RTF/resources/voice stability/cancellation. Treat failure to produce usable incremental audio as a realtime-production falsifier, while preserving offline/high-quality TTS donor value.
